name: Landgasthof Falkenstein
kurzbeschreibung:
**Falkenstein Family Farm Inn in Tirol**

Welcome to **Landgasthof Falkenstein**, a cozy retreat nestled in the heart of **Tirol**, where traditional Tyrolean hospitality meets rustic charm. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, this family-run inn invites you to unwind in a serene alpine setting.

Indulge in hearty **Tiroler** cuisine—think crispy **Kaiserschmarrn**, savory **Gröstl**, and tender **Kaspressknödel**—all crafted with local ingredients. The rustic dining room, adorned with wooden beams and warm lighting, is the perfect spot to savor your meal while enjoying panoramic views of the surrounding mountains.

After a day of hiking, skiing, or exploring **Tirol’s** scenic trails, relax in our cozy guest rooms, each offering a taste of alpine life with handcrafted furniture and mountain vistas. Whether you're seeking adventure or tranquility, **Landgasthof Falkenstein** promises an authentic escape into the soul of **Tirol**.
